T_StockImpact.description: Why a company is impacted by a shock/geography/event — shortest impact path.
T_StockImpact.example_query: Why are ICICI Lombard stocks impacted by Hormuz disruption?
T_StockImpact.cypher:
MATCH (source:Node {id: $source_id}), (target:Node {id: $target_id})
WHERE source <> target
MATCH p = shortestPath((source)-[*..12]-(target))
RETURN
  source.label AS source_name,
  target.label AS target_name,
  [n IN nodes(p) | n.label] AS path_names,
  [n IN nodes(p) | n.type] AS path_types,
  [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rel_types,
  length(p) AS hops

T_CausalChain.description: Trace causal transmission between two entities through typed edges.
T_CausalChain.example_query: How does Hormuz disruption lead to higher Brent crude price?
T_CausalChain.cypher:
MATCH (source:Node {id: $source_id}), (target:Node {id: $target_id})
MATCH p = (source)-[:CAUSES|TRANSITS|HURT_BY|BENEFITS_FROM|NEEDS|PRODUCES|CONTAINS|PRICE_LINKED_TO|SOURCED_FROM*1..10]->(target)
RETURN
  source.label AS source_name,
  target.label AS target_name,
  [n IN nodes(p) | n.label] AS path_names,
  [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rel_types,
  length(p) AS hops
ORDER BY hops
LIMIT 10

T_Beneficiary.description: Companies with positive exposure (BENEFITS_FROM) to a shock or macro variable.
T_Beneficiary.example_query: Which companies benefit from higher Brent crude price?
T_Beneficiary.cypher:
MATCH (company:Node {type: 'COMPANY'})-[:BENEFITS_FROM]->(shock:Node {id: $source_id})
RETURN
  company.id AS id,
  company.label AS name,
  company.type AS node_type,
  shock.label AS shock_name

T_CompareExposure.description: Compare hop distance / exposure paths of two companies to the same shock.
T_CompareExposure.example_query: Compare ONGC and Oil India exposure to oil supply shock.
T_CompareExposure.cypher:
MATCH (a:Node {id: $source_id}), (b:Node {id: $target_id}), (shock:Node {id: $shock_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH pa = shortestPath((a)-[*..12]-(shock))
OPTIONAL MATCH pb = shortestPath((b)-[*..12]-(shock))
RETURN
  a.label AS company_a,
  b.label AS company_b,
  shock.label AS shock_name,
  length(pa) AS hops_a,
  length(pb) AS hops_b,
  [n IN nodes(pa) | n.label] AS path_a,
  [n IN nodes(pb) | n.label] AS path_b

T_ConstraintRisk.description: Physical or supply bottlenecks constraining an entity or sector.
T_ConstraintRisk.example_query: What constrains NTPC growth in AI infrastructure capex?
T_ConstraintRisk.cypher:
MATCH (entity:Node {id: $source_id})-[:CONSTRAINED_BY]->(constraint:Node)
RETURN
  entity.label AS entity_name,
  constraint.label AS constraint_name,
  constraint.type AS constraint_type
UNION
MATCH (constraint:Node)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(entity:Node {id: $source_id})
RETURN
  entity.label AS entity_name,
  constraint.label AS constraint_name,
  constraint.type AS constraint_type

T_EventScenario.description: Downstream macro and company impact from an event scenario.
T_EventScenario.example_query: What if Strait of Hormuz closes completely?
T_EventScenario.cypher:
MATCH (event:Node {id: $source_id})-[r:CAUSES|HURT_BY]->(impacted:Node)
RETURN
  event.label AS event_name,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  impacted.label AS impacted_name,
  impacted.type AS impacted_type
ORDER BY impacted.type, impacted.label

T_Hedging.description: Natural or financial hedges used by a company.
T_Hedging.example_query: How does Reliance Industries hedge against USD/INR volatility?
T_Hedging.cypher:
MATCH (company:Node {id: $source_id})-[r:HEDGES]->(hedge:Node)
RETURN
  company.label AS company_name,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  hedge.label AS hedge_target,
  hedge.type AS hedge_type

T_InvestmentFlow.description: Investors deploying capital into a company or sector.
T_InvestmentFlow.example_query: Who invests in data centre ecosystem in India?
T_InvestmentFlow.cypher:
MATCH (investor:Node)-[r:INVESTS_IN]->(target:Node {id: $target_id})
RETURN
  investor.label AS investor_name,
  investor.type AS investor_type,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  target.label AS target_name,
  target.type AS target_type

T_MacroTransmission.description: How a macro variable transmits to a company through the graph.
T_MacroTransmission.example_query: How does RBI policy rate affect Bajaj Finance?
T_MacroTransmission.cypher:
MATCH (macro:Node {id: $source_id}), (company:Node {id: $target_id})
WHERE macro <> company
MATCH p = shortestPath((macro)-[*..10]-(company))
RETURN
  macro.label AS macro_name,
  company.label AS company_name,
  [n IN nodes(p) | n.label] AS path_names,
  [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rel_types,
  length(p) AS hops

T_OwnershipStructure.description: Corporate ownership, subsidiaries, and JV structure.
T_OwnershipStructure.cypher:
MATCH (parent:Node)-[r:OWNS|SUBSIDIARY_OF|JV_WITH]->(child:Node)
WHERE parent.id = $source_id OR child.id = $source_id
RETURN
  parent.label AS parent_name,
  parent.type AS parent_type,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  child.label AS child_name,
  child.type AS child_type

T_PriceLinkage.description: Price co-movement between a company/product and a macro or raw material.
T_PriceLinkage.example_query: How is Asian Paints linked to Brent crude price?
T_PriceLinkage.cypher:
MATCH (entity:Node {id: $source_id})-[r:PRICE_LINKED_TO]->(linked:Node)
RETURN
  entity.label AS entity_name,
  entity.type AS entity_type,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  linked.label AS linked_name,
  linked.type AS linked_type
UNION
MATCH (linked:Node)-[r:PRICE_LINKED_TO]->(entity:Node {id: $source_id})
RETURN
  entity.label AS entity_name,
  entity.type AS entity_type,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  linked.label AS linked_name,
  linked.type AS linked_type

T_RegulatoryImpact.description: Policy, subsidy, or regulatory constraints on a company.
T_RegulatoryImpact.example_query: How is Indian Oil affected by LPG subsidy policy?
T_RegulatoryImpact.cypher:
MATCH (company:Node {id: $source_id})-[r:REGULATED_BY]->(policy:Node)
RETURN
  company.label AS company_name,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  policy.label AS policy_name,
  policy.type AS policy_type

T_SectorExposure.description: Sector membership and constituent companies exposed to a theme.
T_SectorExposure.example_query: Which companies are in Banks & NBFCs sector?
T_SectorExposure.cypher:
MATCH (sector:Node {id: $source_id})-[:CONTAINS]->(company:Node {type: 'COMPANY'})
RETURN
  sector.label AS sector_name,
  company.id AS id,
  company.label AS name,
  company.type AS node_type
ORDER BY company.label

T_SupplyDisruption.description: Input needs, sourcing geography, and supply-chain exposure.
T_SupplyDisruption.example_query: How does Hormuz disruption disrupt crude oil supply?
T_SupplyDisruption.cypher:
MATCH (entity:Node {id: $source_id})-[r:NEEDS|SOURCED_FROM|SUPPLIES_TO]->(linked:Node)
RETURN
  entity.label AS entity_name,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  linked.label AS linked_name,
  linked.type AS linked_type
ORDER BY relationship, linked_name

T_TransitRisk.example_query: How much Indian crude oil transits through Strait of Hormuz?
T_TransitRisk.cypher:
MATCH (commodity:Node)-[r:TRANSITS]->(geo:Node {id: $target_id})
RETURN
  commodity.label AS commodity_name,
  commodity.type AS commodity_type,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  geo.label AS chokepoint,
  r.channel AS channel
ORDER BY commodity_name
